reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis overstates the role of configurational entropy in causing sluggish diffusion and ignores the well-documented effects of chemical complexity on defect recombination, making the proposed mechanism physically questionable.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with a well-defined falsification criterion based on quantitative microstructural comparisons, though the 'order-of-magnitude' threshold is somewhat arbitrary.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a relevant property (radiation tolerance) but focuses narrowly on a contested mechanism (sluggish diffusion) without connecting to the broader phase stability and multi-property requirements of the research question.
